fact: A 4 June 2026 workshop led by the Pagir coordinator validated the draft bidding document to recruit a firm to design, develop and deploy a national public-procurement e-platform, with a World Bank-recruited consultant.

The public procurement regulator ARMP says a workshop on 21-22 July 2026 adopted the tender file to hire the firm that will develop and deploy the e-GP electronic procurement system, pending steering-committee validation.

Decree 2024-2072 of 10 October 2024 establishes an electronic public procurement system (e-GP) run by the ARMP covering the cycle from programming to archiving, to be deployed in two phases, first among public actors and then with bidders included.
